stages.capability: Source-faithful Silver and reviewed Gold with explicit unknowns
stages.current_failure: Structural and field-state evidence does not establish every required source meaning or semantic relationship.
stages.next_action: Resolve only interpretations or reviewed relationships required by the declared consumer contract; reconcile every field state and retain unsupported values as unresolved.
stages.completion_evidence: Existing exact-source semantic, field-state, reviewed-control and producer receipts satisfy the required product contract.
stages.stop_condition: Stop interpretation work when that contract passes or lacks supporting evidence; carry missing evidence as a blocker and advance independent system tasks.
stages.validation: Select affected contract or matcher tests and their negative controls; reuse unchanged corpus receipts.

stages.capability: Qualified producer output reaches independently admitted v4 delivery
stages.current_failure: Candidate producer output and existing object canaries do not establish complete admitted-product delivery.
stages.next_action: Trace an existing eligible Silver output through the producer, v4 admission and remote-reader boundary; fix the first shared contract failure and apply the same path to mandatory eligible outputs.
stages.completion_evidence: Exact identity, lineage, rights, qualification, admission and authorized delivery receipts for the required outputs, using existing qualifiers.
stages.stop_condition: Stop custom dataset work once the shared path works; record object-specific missing evidence without inventing admission or expanding the frozen inventory.
stages.validation: Use affected federation admission, distribution and reader selectors, then an authorized bounded admitted-product canary.

stages.capability: API, CLI, Atlas and exports consume the same qualified revisions
stages.current_failure: The six-table July 2025 MBS Silver cohort passes bounded live API, CLI, Atlas and deterministic JSONL export canaries; additional output cohorts remain blocked before admission, so they have no consumer receipts yet.
stages.next_action: Retain the revision- and digest-bound six-table receipts with provenance, bounded coverage and semantic limits. Reuse the same canary path only when another required output clears its identity, lineage, rights, semantics and admission gates.
stages.completion_evidence: Revision- and digest-bound API, CLI, Atlas and deterministic export receipts with explicit coverage and semantic limits.
stages.stop_condition: Close the shared consumer capability after required paths pass; add more datasets only when their profile exposes an uncovered mandatory behavior.
stages.validation: For each newly admitted output, select affected consumer integration and export checks and retain exact revision, object and semantic digests; preserve complete protected hosted checks.

stages.current_failure: Primary restoration and byte closure alone do not establish the independent recovery and compatibility checkpoints.
stages.next_action: Exercise existing restore and compatibility machinery for required qualified outputs; record unavailable independent recovery authority as its own blocker.
stages.completion_evidence: Required clean-room restore, independent recovery and compatibility receipts under their existing authority and acceptance contracts.
stages.stop_condition: Retain failed or unavailable recovery evidence explicitly; do not relabel duplicate primary storage as independent recovery or repeatedly retry an unchanged authority blocker.
stages.validation: Use affected restore and compatibility selectors and one bounded authorized rehearsal for the applicable failure mode.

stages.capability: Existing Stable v1 acceptance and promotion close with observable evidence
stages.current_failure: The authoritative Stable v1 reconciliation still retains Australian federation as unresolved.
stages.next_action: Reconcile the existing requirement and release contract after system evidence changes; resolve required M-105/M-107 or other blockers only through their existing decision contracts.
stages.completion_evidence: Existing qualification contract and readiness reconciliation pass, followed by exact candidate, protected checks and attestation under the existing conditional promotion approval.
stages.stop_condition: Do not claim stable qualification, issue a release or waive a dependent requirement from this scheduling plan; stop at the existing release and authority boundaries.
stages.validation: Run affected reconciliation tests and required final integration, package, security and release gates once at the coherent system milestone.
